title: Thadrak Kanjur gZungs 'dus E
shelf_note: Dhāraṇī collection (Avalokiteśvara dhāraṇīs) from a Kanjur gZungs 'dus volume; matches the catalogue.
structure_note: The image is one EAP photograph of two pecha folios. The transcription keeps them apart with <leaf-break/>. The top folio ends 'ཞག་བདུན་གྱིས་' and the bottom one begins 'ཕྱག་བཞི་པ', so the two sides do not run on; that is how the photograph pairs sides, not a splice.

title: Nor rgyam dbang skor

structure_note: Only 65 of 130 pages are counted as OCR'd in the book field, but structure shows 130 with OCR; 61 translated. Two printed backsteps and one repeat come from 6 printed numbers only; probably misread marginal numerals. The image holds three folios in one photograph.

title: Tshe khrid rdo rje phreng ba'i skor (EAP039-1-4-160)
shelf_note: These folios are a narrative of King Trisong Detsen and the Mal-gro nāga at Samye, not a longevity instruction. A bound miscellany under the cycle's title is plausible, so not called wrong.
structure_note: 196 pages with OCR but only 57 translated. One backstep comes from just 3 printed numbers; probably a misread numeral. The page's narrative content may be a separate text bound in the volume.

tr_errors.english: They cut [the top of] their noses <note>a traditional form of oath-taking</note>
tr_errors.problem: the phrase is taken literally, and a note is added to justify it

book_verdict: Three folios of dbu med (cursive) script. The opening 'ལ་བཀྲིས་པ' and the onomatopoeic run on the third folio ('ཚ་ཙག་ཙག… སྲོ་བྱེར་བྱེར') match the image's layout, but the small cursive could not be checked word by word. The translation is fluent and faithful to the transcription.
